title: Denying, Admitting, Answering Back
goal: Report a denial, an admission and an answer back, with the right mood or with haber + participle.
grammar: Denying and admitting: negar, desmentir, admitir, reconocer, replicar

items: I can report a denial with negar que + subjunctive or negar + haber + participle, and an admission with admitir que + indicative.
I can report that someone answered back or objected with replicar or objetar + que.
I can use the new words for contradicting and opposing.
